faqs.q: 1. What is the eligibility criteria for admission into Diploma in Computer Science & Technology?
faqs.a: Candidates must have passed 10th Standard / Madhyamik examination or equivalent with a minimum of 35% aggregate marks (including Mathematics, Physical Science, and English). Admissions are conducted through the West Bengal State Council JEXPO counseling examination or direct institutional quota counseling under WBSCTVESD guidelines. There is no upper age limit.

faqs.q: 2. Can 10+2 (Science/Vocational) or ITI students join directly in the 2nd year through lateral entry?
faqs.a: Yes. Students having passed 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Computer Science OR 10th + 2-year ITI in relevant computer trades (COPA, IT) with a valid VOCLET rank are eligible for direct lateral admission into the 2nd Year (3rd Semester), completing their diploma degree in just 2 years.

faqs.q: 3. Which programming languages, frameworks, and tools are taught in the CST department at NHIT?
faqs.a: Students receive thorough hands-on training in C, C++, Core Java, Python, and modern Web Technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, RESTful APIs). On the infrastructure side, students learn Relational Database Management Systems (PostgreSQL / MySQL), Linux system administration, Docker basics, and Cisco Packet Tracer network simulation.

faqs.q: 4. What are the laboratory facilities available for Computer Science & Technology students?
faqs.a: NHIT features 7 specialized computing laboratories outfitted with high-performance desktop machines, Gigabit local area networking, high-speed leased line internet, dual-boot Linux/Windows environments, dedicated database servers, and modern IoT trainer kits with Arduino and ESP32 microcontrollers.

faqs.q: 5. What kind of campus placements do CST students receive at NHIT?
faqs.a: The CST department boasts an 85–90% placement and higher education transition rate. Students are recruited as Associate Software Engineers, Web Developers, Database Analysts, and Network Support Executives by IT service leaders and tech firms with salary packages reaching up to ₹4.8 LPA (median ₹2.8 LPA).

faqs.q: 6. Can diploma CST holders pursue B.Tech through lateral entry?
faqs.a: Yes, diploma holders can appear for the West Bengal state-level JELET examination for direct entry into the 2nd Year (3rd Semester) of B.Tech / B.E. programs in Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, or emerging domains like AI & Machine Learning at institutions such as Jadavpur University, KGEC, JGEC, and Heritage.

faqs.q: 7. Are separate hostel and Wi-Fi facilities available on campus for students?
faqs.a: Yes. NHIT maintains separate, secure in-campus hostels for boys and girls with 24/7 security, high-speed Wi-Fi internet access, hygienic dining halls serving balanced meals, round-the-clock water, and recreational rooms.

diploma-in-mechanical-engineering.narrative: Mechanical Engineering at NHIT Durgapur stands at the core of eastern India's heavy manufacturing, metallurgy, and infrastructure renaissance. Rooted in Durgapur's industrial heartland, our department combines fundamental physical engineering with computerized manufacturing. Students spend extensive hours across 8 fully equipped machine shops—operating industrial center lathes, universal milling stations, computerized Universal Testing Machines (UTM), and CNC turning simulators. Backed by regular industrial immersions at SAIL Durgapur Steel Plant, our graduates are highly prized by national steel, infrastructure, and heavy automotive corporations.

faqs.q: 1. What is the eligibility criteria for admission into Diploma in Civil Engineering?
faqs.a: Applicants must have cleared 10th Standard / Madhyamik examination or equivalent with at least 35% marks in aggregate. Admission is granted through state-level JEXPO counseling conducted by WBSCTVESD, or through direct institutional counseling per government norms. No upper age barrier applies.

faqs.q: 2. Can students with ITI (Draughtsman Civil / Surveyor) or 10+2 join directly in 2nd year?
faqs.a: Yes! Candidates who have completed 10+2 with PCM or passed 10th standard along with a 2-year ITI in trades like Draughtsman Civil or Surveyor with a valid VOCLET rank can enter directly into the 3rd Semester (2nd Year) through lateral entry, finishing the entire diploma in 2 academic years.

faqs.q: 3. What field instruments and software are students trained on in Civil Engineering?
faqs.a: Civil engineering students at NHIT train on modern electronic Total Stations, digital auto-levels, transit theodolites, and GPS receivers for field surveying. In software labs, students master 2D drafting and structural detailing in AutoCAD Civil 3D, and learn structural frame analysis in STAAD.Pro.

faqs.q: 4. What heavy testing equipment is available in the Civil Engineering laboratories?
faqs.a: The department is equipped with a digital Compression Testing Machine (CTM) for concrete cube strength, direct shear apparatus and triaxial cells for soil testing, Los Angeles abrasion machine for aggregate testing, bitumen penetration/ductility rigs, and a water & wastewater testing PHE laboratory.

faqs.q: 5. What are the primary job profiles and companies hiring NHIT civil diploma graduates?
faqs.a: Graduates are hired as Site Construction Engineers, Structural Draftsmen, Quantity Surveyors, Quality Control (QA/QC) Inspectors, and PHE Supervisors by top infrastructure giants like Larsen & Toubro (L&T Construction), Shapoorji Pallonji, Afcons, Simplex Infrastructures, and Gammon India with packages up to ₹4.5 LPA.

faqs.q: 6. What government recruitment exams can a civil engineering diploma holder take?
faqs.a: Diploma civil engineers are in highest demand across public sector exams including SSC-JE (Staff Selection Commission), RRB-JE (Indian Railways Works & Permanent Way), West Bengal Public Works Department (PWD-JE), Irrigation & Waterways Directorate, KMDA, and municipal corporations.

faqs.q: 7. How does lateral entry to B.Tech Civil Engineering work after diploma?
faqs.a: Through the state JELET entrance test, diploma holders secure direct lateral admission into the 2nd Year (3rd Semester) of 4-year B.Tech Civil Engineering at premier colleges such as Jadavpur University, IIEST Shibpur, Kalyani Govt. Engineering College, and Jalpaiguri Govt. Engineering College.
